checkedAlternates.risk: Bernoulli is a discrete distribution like Poisson.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Bernoulli takes only two values {0, 1} (group-1), whereas Poisson and Geometric span all non-negative integers (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Exponential distribution is bounded below at 0.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Exponential has support [0, ∞), which is unbounded above (group-4).
